chunks: Look, how they double up their breasts in order to hide from Him. But when they cover themselves up with their garments, He knows what they hide and what they expose. Indeed, He knows the secrets of the hearts.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Allah knowing the secrets of the heart?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Hud, this verse highlights Allah's omniscience regarding the hidden secrets of the heart, contrasting human attempts to conceal their true nature with divine awareness. Shia scholarship often interprets 'what they hide and what they reveal' as encompassing both internal intentions (niyyah) and external actions, emphasizing that no layer of concealment, whether physical or spiritual, escapes the All-Knowing. This serves as a reminder for believers to maintain sincerity (ikhlas) in their inner states, not just their outward deeds.
